tagline: Uno and Aura — hip-hop fun, dressed up.
credit: Credit ProgressiveSlop on the title card and the end card (with the tagline).
summary: Glossy, hyper-detailed chrome 3D illustration in neon purple, magenta and cyan. Everything is a robot: polished silver chrome bodies, glowing red eyes, headphones for ears. Uno and Aura are the recurring leads; each song changes the setting, never the brand.
rules: Everything is a robot. No living creatures: no humans, animals or plants that are alive (crystal/chrome trees are fine).
All robots are polished silver chrome with glowing red eyes and headphones for ears.
Look: glossy, hyper-detailed chrome 3D illustration; neon purple, magenta and cyan lighting; reflective floors.
The setting changes with each song's theme; the brand (chrome robots, Uno and Aura, palette) stays the same.
Uno's pendant must read as a gold "1" (stamp it with scripts/pendant_one.py if a generation draws a cross).

leads.Uno: the strong male lead: big heroic build, smooth round bald chrome head, glowing red eyes, headphones, purple fur cloak, gold chain with a "1" pendant. Protector.
leads.Aura: the beautiful, graceful lady: chrome body, long dark hair streaked crimson, crimson and silver gown, glowing red eyes, headphones. Brings grace and magic (cyan spell light).

type.title: Cinzel Decorative 900 with a chrome gradient fill, ink stroke and magenta glow
type.brand: Orbitron 900, white with magenta/cyan neon glow
type.sfx: Bangers, stroked + offset ink shadow, magenta/cyan

comic: Comic-book layer on top of the chrome art: panels and gutters, halftone, SFX lettering, speech bubbles, impact stars, speed lines.
motion: Every character on screen is alive all the time (actor kit: breathing, head bob on its own phase, eye glow pulses and blinks, headphone pulses, cloth/hair sway, chrome glints); pose changes use anticipation, smear and overshoot; backgrounds have subtle light motion.
do: Uno and Aura in every song
